summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Diagnostic cells: Porifera = Choanocytes (collar cells); Cnidaria = Cnidocytes (stinging nematocysts); Ctenophora = Colloblasts (lasso cells); Platyhelminthes = Flame cells (protonephridia).

conceptBreakdown.content: Basal metazoan lineages encompass cellular sponges, diploblastic radially symmetrical coelenterates and ctenophores, and bilaterally symmetrical acoelomate flatworms.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.1 Phylum Porifera (Sponges)
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.1 Phylum Porifera (Sponges)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
WATER CANAL PATHWAY (SYCONOID)
                      
   Ostia ──► Incurrent Canal ──► Prosopyle ──► Radial Canal (Choanocytes)
                                                   │
   Osculum ◄── Spongocoel ◄── Apolypyle ───────────┘
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Organization & Symmetry**: Cellular level; asymmetrical or radial; marine organisms lacking true tissues, organs, or nerves.
• **Diagnostic Cells (Choanocytes)**: Interior cavity (**Spongocoel**) and radial canals are lined by specialized flagellated collar cells (**Choanocytes**) that generate water currents and ingest food via intracellular phagocytosis.
• **Water Canal System**: Water enters minute incurrent pores (**Ostia**) into the central spongocoel and exits through a large terminal **Osculum**.
  - Types: *Asconoid* (simplest) $\rightarrow$ *Syconoid* $\rightarrow$ *Leuconoid* (most complex, spongocoel replaced by branched flagellated chambers).
• **Skeleton & Reproduction**: Supported by microscopic spicules ($\text{CaCO}_3$ or hydrated silica $\text{SiO}_2$) or organic **Spongin Fibers**. Hermaphroditic (monoecious); asexual gemmules contain totipotent **archeocytes**; indirect development via flagellated **Amphiblastula** or **Parenchymula** larvae.
• **Key Taxa**: *Sycon* (*Scypha*), *Spongilla* (freshwater), *Euspongia* (bath sponge), *Euplectella* ("Venus' Flower Basket").

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.2 Phylum Cnidaria & Metagenesis
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.2 Phylum Cnidaria & Metagenesis
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
CNIDARIAN METAGENESIS
                           
         Polyp (2n) ──[Asexual Budding]──► Medusa (2n)
             ▲                                 │
             │                                 ▼
       Planula Larva ◄── [Syngamy] ◄── Gametes (n)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Organization & Symmetry**: Tissue level; radial symmetry; diploblastic with gelatinous non-cellular **mesoglea**.
• **Diagnostic Cells (Cnidocytes)**: Epidermal stinging cells containing explosive **Nematocysts** filled with paralyzing hypnotoxin toxin, used for anchorage, defense, and prey capture.
• **Gastrovascular Cavity**: Single central **Coelenteron** with a single opening (mouth/anus) on an elevated **hypostome**.
• **Dimorphism & Metagenesis**: Alternation of generations between sessile asexual **Polyp** ($2n$) and free-swimming sexual **Medusa** ($2n$) phases (e.g., *Obelia*):
  $$\text{Polyp } (2n) \xrightarrow{\text{Asexual Budding}} \text{Medusa } (2n) \xrightarrow{\text{Sexual Gametic Fusion}} \text{Planula Larva} \longrightarrow \text{Polyp } (2n)$$
• **Key Taxa**: *Physalia* ("Portuguese Man-of-War"), *Adamsia* (sea anemone), *Pennatula* (sea pen), *Gorgonia* (sea fan), *Meandrina* (brain coral), *Hydra*.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 2.3 Phylum Ctenophora (Comb Jellies) & 2.4 Phylum Platyhelminthes (Flatworms)
conceptBreakdown.title: 2.3 Phylum Ctenophora & 2.4 Phylum Platyhelminthes
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
FLAME CELL (PROTONEPHRIDIUM)
                      
     Ciliary Tuft ("Flame") ──► Capillary Funnel ──► Excretory Duct ──► Nephridiopore
conceptBreakdown.content:
### Phylum Ctenophora (Sea Walnuts / Comb Jellies)
• **Comb Plates & Colloblasts**: Exclusively marine; biradial symmetry; possesses **8 external rows of ciliated comb plates (ctenes)** for locomotion.
• **Colloblasts (Lasso Cells)**: Adhesive, non-stinging prey-capturing cells on retractile tentacles (cnidocytes are absent).
• **Bioluminescence**: Well-marked light emission via enzymatic ctenophorin oxidation; indirect development via **Cydippid Larva** (e.g., *Pleurobrachia*, *Ctenoplana*).

### Phylum Platyhelminthes (Flatworms)
• **Body Plan**: Bilateral symmetry; triploblastic; **acoelomate**; dorsoventrally flattened solid parenchyma body.
• **Parasitic Adaptations**: Endoparasites (*Taenia*, *Fasciola*) exhibit thick syncytial tegument, **hooks and suckers**, reduced gut, and immense fecundity.
• **Excretory Flame Cells**: Specialized protonephridia with beating ciliary tufts for **osmoregulation and excretion**.
• **Regeneration & Larval Stages**: High epimorphic regeneration in *Planaria* (*Dugesia*). Liver fluke larvae: *Miracidium* $\rightarrow$ *Sporocyst* $\rightarrow$ *Redia* $\rightarrow$ *Cercaria* $\rightarrow$ *Metacercaria*.
